title: StylusTools
tagline: A set of EVM smart contracts written in Rust, which make using Arbitrum Stylus much easier
description: Our project aims to develop a foundational toolkit of smart contracts written in Rust for use on Arbitrum Stylus. Arbitrum Stylus, an innovative layer 2 scaling solution for Ethereum, offers reduced costs and increased transaction speeds. By leveraging the Rust programming language, known for its safety and performance benefits, our smart contracts will provide a robust and efficient base for developers to build upon.
how_its_made:
By delivering a reliable and well-documented Rust-based smart contract toolkit, we aim to accelerate the adoption and growth of decentralized applications (dApps) on Arbitrum Stylus. Developers will benefit from increased productivity, reduced development costs, and enhanced security, ultimately driving innovation and scalability within the Ethereum ecosystem.

This project is open-source and welcomes contributions from the community. Join us in shaping the future of decentralized finance and applications on Arbitrum Stylus with Rust-powered smart contracts.
